document: RastalR Architecture Gap Audit and Proposed Continuation
audit_scope: Read-only inventory, documentation, reference-contract, and selected validator-source review. Not a fresh execution of every validation/test or a reapproval of artwork.
original_plan_finding: The committed Architecture Master Plan v1.0 inspected defines A1, A2, and B. An itemized locked D/E list and a binding 45-asset quota were not found in the inspected planning documents. Earlier conversation describes D/E only broadly.
counting_policy: Count independently useful logical assets/states, not masks, exports, previews, or implementation PNG components. Candidate orientations only earn new records if actually useful and non-duplicative.

D.name: Clear glass partition, back-facing straight
D.purpose: Make a genuinely transparent, repeatable divider from the canonical 28 px glass-partition reference.
D.constraint: Reference dimensions exist; repeat joins, support points, and alpha contract still require validation.

D.name: Clear glass partition, left-side boundary
D.purpose: Allow glass partitions to turn into a depth-running wall on the left.
D.constraint: Derive camera-aware geometry from topology; do not rotate the back-facing PNG.

D.name: Clear glass partition, right-side boundary
D.purpose: Provide the separately rendered right-side boundary with consistent upper-left light.
D.constraint: Derive geometry and lighting independently; no automatic mirrored artwork.

D.name: Clear glass partition, front cutaway
D.purpose: Close a glass enclosure on its foreground side without hiding the room.
D.constraint: Define reduced-height presentation explicitly; do not assume the full-height/back sprite applies.

D.name: Internal observation window
D.purpose: A sealed viewing window in a solid clinical wall; not a door.
D.constraint: Proposed two-cell back-wall carrier; frame and glass are separate alpha roles. No baked second room.

D.name: Patient-room exterior window
D.purpose: An exterior-facing sash-and-sill window, visibly different from an interior observation pane.
D.constraint: Proposed two-cell carrier. Make any daylight/background insert optional rather than part of modular geometry.

D.name: Wall-integrated service hatch
D.purpose: A wall opening with a transfer sill for a pharmacy/reception counter.
D.constraint: Not another freestanding reception desk. Determine protruding sill envelope and reuse existing counters where appropriate.

D.name: Low solid partition, back-facing straight
D.purpose: A visibly lower, permanent divider for a nurses station or waiting zone.
D.constraint: Height requires a new explicit contract; do not silently replace canonical full-height walls.

D.name: Low solid partition, left-side boundary
D.purpose: Turn a low solid divider into the depth axis.
D.constraint: Conditional on a genuinely distinct rendered module. Reuse existing parts if the derived presentation is identical.

D.name: Low solid partition, right-side boundary
D.purpose: Complete low-divider enclosures with the corresponding right-side presentation.
D.constraint: Conditional on a genuinely distinct rendered module. No duplicate inventory for an identical existing part.

E.name: Structural column / pier
E.purpose: Provide a freestanding structural support and a deliberate visual termination where useful.
E.constraint: Does not substitute for proving ordinary wall junctions. Grid anchor and wall-height relation must be explicit.

E.name: Elevator entrance, closed
E.purpose: Provide a recognizable vertical-circulation entrance with an elevator-specific surround and call control.
E.constraint: Not C6 relabeled. Any text/display glyphs are deterministic; carrier size is proposed, not validated.

E.name: Elevator entrance, open
E.purpose: The matching open-cabin state of E2.
E.constraint: Preserve E2 frame and origin. Cabin backing is a declared visual component, not evidence of engine functionality.

E.name: Stairs ascending
E.purpose: Allow a layout to communicate access to an upper floor.
E.constraint: Footprint is provisional. Requires a new elevation/landing scaffold, collision guidance, and camera proof.

E.name: Stairs descending
E.purpose: A distinct descending/stairwell view for access to a lower floor.
E.constraint: Not a flipped ascending image. Opening, edge protection, landings, and draw order require validation.

planning_totals.important: Do not manufacture assets to hit 45. D9/D10 may be reused instead of newly counted; demonstrated adapters/orientation needs can change the final scope.

findings.finding: D/E scope needs a real persistent document, not a count-based reconstruction from chat history.
findings.action: Review and adopt or amend this proposal before production.

findings.finding: The C5 validator main() writes deviation_source_px=0, drift=none, matches_spec=True, reconstruction result=pass and clipping=False as report literals. It computes alpha/component values but does not independently measure each of those art-geometry claims.
findings.action: Separate assumed/spec coordinates from measured evidence and human review. Add failure-producing checks and deliberate bad fixtures before new material families.

findings.finding: Canonical Architecture v2 names a 28 px transparent glass partition, not a new 52 px opaque wall.
findings.action: Use the 32x28 reference as D1 starting point; specify contact geometry and alpha treatment separately.

findings.finding: C7 intentionally retains an opaque recessed backing. A visually open image is not automatically a see-through opening into an adjacent room. C2/C5 components are lower projection portions, not full independent animated leaves.
findings.action: Preserve approved sources. Document static use and alpha/draw-order behavior; do not advertise unimplemented animation or see-through capability.

findings.finding: Current visible architecture inventory covers floors, solid wall directions and back-facing opening states. Full production behavior for ends/L/T/cross junctions and side/front openings is not established merely by a straight corridor montage.
findings.action: Exercise existing assets and topology first. Add only connection pieces shown necessary by those tests.

findings.finding: Batch 12 QA Markdown still has an awaiting-human-review headline and contains its human-approval section twice; the JSON final status is approved.
findings.action: Correct summary generation idempotently without changing approval decisions or artwork.

findings.finding: Repository metadata reported visibility=public at audit time.
findings.action: Owner should confirm that public exposure of source and production art is intentional; no visibility setting changed by this audit.

D0_readiness_gate.purpose: Small contract and evidence setup before D1; not a new artwork batch or a broad rewrite.
D0_readiness_gate.preserve: All 220 approved logical assets, existing source files, PNG hashes, historical provenance, and approval decisions.
D0_readiness_gate.geometry_convention: Explicit half-open [left,top,right,bottom) rectangles, native/source scale relationship, contact regions, render origins, and separate footprints.
required_tests: Repeat D1 scaffold without doubled mullions or alpha darkening at shared joins.
Show known colored shapes/props behind the glass and verify expected alpha behavior.
Build small L, T, cross and connected-two-room scenes using existing approved architecture plus reference-only proposed geometry.
Fail deliberately shifted overlay/contact edge and removed connector fixtures.
Treat visual continuity as reviewed or measured evidence, never unconditional pass literals.
D0_readiness_gate.reporting: Expected versus observed versus human-reviewed fields must be distinguished. Preserve old evidence; append limitations/corrections rather than silently rewriting history.
D0_readiness_gate.output_scope: Reference-only D1 geometry contract, reproducible scaffold/overlay/masks, focused tests, and a compact review montage. No new inventory records.

model_recommendation.effort: High for this contract/QA task; Medium for later bounded extraction/promotion
model_recommendation.new_chat: New thread on the same Hospital repository after scope approval

deferred_or_reused: Repeated freestanding privacy curtains/screens or reception counters
Standalone topology masks counted as assets
Automatic side/front variants of every C1-C8 state
Exterior facades, entrance canopies, roads, roofs and vehicles
Game behavior or animation implied by static images
